pixel_area_policy: not premultiplied; CUDA applies pix_area=4*pi/Npix at runtime
generation_method: per-pixel log-log polynomial fit of degree 1: log(B_nu)=a0+a1*log(nu)[+a2*log(nu)^2], then evaluated at target frequency
usage: derived frequency-scaled workload; suitable for controlled experiments, not an independent SAO simulation
note: Uses existing same-coordinate same-order SAO maps. If absorption produces strong curvature, degree=1 is an effective spectral-index extrapolation; degree=2 should be treated as sensitivity analysis.
